title: Capstone Holding Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Capstone Holding Corp (ticker: CAPS), a small-cap Nasdaq-listed company headquartered in Alsip, Illinois, filed an 8-K disclosing a conversion price adjustment on its October 2025 Convertible Note. The conversion price was reduced to $0.57 for $500,000 of principal amount (previously $1.10), effective April 16, 2026. The remaining principal balance on that note is approximately $1.86 million.
key_points: Capstone Holding Corp issued senior secured convertible notes to an institutional investor in July 2025 (~$3.27M principal) and October 2025 (~$3.55M principal)
On April 16, 2026, the conversion price on $500,000 of October 2025 Note principal was reduced from $1.10 to $0.57
As of April 16, 2026, the outstanding principal balance on the October 2025 Convertible Note was $1,863,471.69
The July 2025 Convertible Note had its conversion price reduced from $1.72 to $0.75
Total registered shares for conversion: 8,388,336 shares of Common Stock
Company is an emerging growth company under SEC definitions
why_it_matters: This is a company-specific financing event for a micro/small-cap issuer involving private convertible debt. It has no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. The conversion price reduction is a routine term adjustment in institutional financing agreements and does not constitute a market-moving event.
